dxf_upload_region_rule: exact canonical filename stem equals server region id
online_rendering: persistent fiber cache + cache-first viewport + instant layer hide/show restore
map_labels: device IDs/pole numbers/address text hidden; details on selection only
line_color_policy: preserve CAD display_color/true_color; fallback distinguishes fiber/coax/cell-boundary/connection lines
device_rendering: one logical device -> one symbol; info/ID/address POINT records are not rendered as devices
zoom_rendering: zoom_changed only toggles in-memory overlay visibility; no API reload
cache_policy: show cache first; fetch only missing/stale area; replace cached bbox only after successful server fetch
